CREATE VIEW cross_border_compliance_gap_view AS 
SELECT 
    df."RecordRegistry" AS flow_id,
    df."FLOWSTAMP" AS flow_timestamp,
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' AS origin_country,
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' AS destination_country,
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'protocol' AS transfer_protocol,
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_actor' AS origin_actor,
    df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_actor' AS destination_actor,
    af."AudtrailState" AS audit_trail_status,
    af."remed_state" AS remediation_status,
    af."border_mech" AS border_mechanism,
    af."TRANSIMPASSESS" AS transfer_impact_assessment,
    c."LEGALBASE" AS legal_basis,
    c."gdprComp" AS gdpr_compliance,
    c."CCPA_COMP" AS ccpa_compliance,
    c."PIPLcomp" AS pipl_compliance,
    c."loc_law_comp" AS local_law_compliance,
    v."VENDASSESS" AS vendor_assessment,
    v."vendSecRate" AS vendor_security_rate,
    v."contrState" AS contract_status,
    v."dpa_state" AS dpa_registration,
    v."SCCSTATE" AS scc_status,
    af.record_registry AS data_record
FROM "DataFlow" df
JOIN "AuditAndCompliance" af ON df."RecordRegistry" = af.record_registry
JOIN "Compliance" c ON af."COMP_JOIN" = c."complianceTrace"
LEFT JOIN "VendorManagement" v ON af."VendJoin" = v."Vendor_Trace"
WHERE df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'origin_country' IS NOT NULL
  AND df.flow_overview->'routing'->>'destination_country' IS NOT NULL
  AND (
      af."AudtrailState" IN ('Missing', 'Partial')
      OR af."remed_state" IN ('Not Started', 'In Progress')
      OR af."TRANSIMPASSESS" IN ('Required', 'In Progress')
      OR c."LEGALBASE" = 'None'
      OR c."gdprComp" = 'Non-compliant'
      OR c."CCPA_COMP" = 'Non-compliant'
      OR c."PIPLcomp" = 'Non-compliant'
      OR c."loc_law_comp" = 'Non-compliant'
  );
